questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] Which planet in our solar system has the most moons?
A. Saturn
B. Jupiter
C. Neptune
Answer: A. With over 100 moons, Saturn holds the record for the most moons of any planet in our solar system.
questions.de: Welcher Planet unseres Sonnensystems hat die meisten bekannten Monde?
questions.en: Which planet in our solar system has the most known moons?

timeline.labelEn: 128 newly found moons of Saturn are announced, bringing its confirmed total to 274
timeline.labelDe: 128 neu entdeckte Saturnmonde werden bekanntgegeben; damit hat Saturn 274 bestätigte Monde

questions.notes: The count keeps changing with new discoveries: since the March 2025 announcement Saturn has 274 confirmed moons, far ahead of Jupiter.

questions.cardText:
[Paleontology] Which came first, the plant or the seed?
A. The plant
B. The seed
C. They came at the same time
Answer: A. Early plants, like mosses and ferns, reproduced using spores. Seeds evolved later as a more efficient reproductive strategy, allowing plants to survive in a wider range of environments and facilitating the development of more complex plant forms, such as flowering plants and conifers.
questions.de: Die ersten Landpflanzen wie Moose und Farne vermehrten sich durch Sporen. Welche effizientere Fortpflanzungsstruktur entwickelte sich erst später und ermöglichte Pflanzen wie Nadelbäume und Blütenpflanzen?
questions.en: The first land plants, such as mosses and ferns, reproduced using spores. Which more efficient reproductive structure evolved only later, making plants such as conifers and flowering plants possible?

timeline.labelEn: The first seed-bearing plants (early gymnosperms) appear in the Late Devonian
timeline.labelDe: Die ersten Samenpflanzen (frühe Gymnospermen) erscheinen im Oberdevon

questions.notes: The card's either-or question is asked as the underlying fact: plants reproduced by spores long before seeds evolved.
